lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Reform office. Nine of us, four years, and one tabled amendment between the lot of us. It was not mine. I say that up front so you are not disappointed later.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Vesely's, that was. Twelve words into the Handover and then she vanished, and nobody in this building will say the word out loud — not because they are frightened, but because saying it means agreeing it happened.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: You are Vesely. You are supposed to be a cautionary tale and you are standing in our kitchen drinking our tea.
